newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE wheat mixed, stg buffets new crop.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE wheat mixed, stg buffets new crop.

text.p: LIFFE wheat ended a volatile day mixed.
The old crop ended lower, while new crop, buffeted by currency, finished up.

July was the most active month, with 271 of a total 522 lots. It first came down on long liquidation as holders decided to bale out, then found support, which brought it back up, which triggered more liquidation, pushing it down again, one trader explained. Its last traded value was 88.00 stg, 0.45 stg lower on the day.
"It's showing a bit of volatility," he said. "There's still plenty of (old crop) wheat about."

On the new crop, currency dominated. Sellers came in as sterling went above 2.80 marks earlier in the day, but as the currency came back prices recovered. The most active new crop contract, November, last traded 0.35 stg higher at 93.60 stg.
